title: New public event and Space pages ping IndexNow so Bing and other engines see them within minutes
detail:
Nothing in the code pings IndexNow today. Needs a key file served from the site root and a ping on publish. Gate behind envFlag and add its activation gate to docs/RUNBOOKS.md. Context: docs/marketing/off-site-seo-worksheet.md.

Shipped: /api/cron/indexnow (daily, off until INDEXNOW_ENABLED; activation gate in docs/RUNBOOKS.md) posts sitemap URLs changed in the last 26 hours to api.indexnow.org. Key file public/<key>.txt. Needs OWN-099 (Bing verified) before the switch is turned on.
